messages:
olivia: Heads-up — promote for web-service/2026.03.20-rc.1 blocked by deploy-bot, pipeline #4242 failing in staging.
deploy-bot: Promotion paused: CI failures detected on pipeline 4242. Reason: artifact digest mismatch and repeated remote-cache restore timeouts. See logs: https://ci.internal/4242 :warning:
olivia: Can someone grab the logs? I saw a KV cache miss spam in the runner logs earlier.
ryan: Looking now. On first glance the artifact uploaded by build-4209 has digest abcdef1234, but the promote step expects abcdef1234+sig mismatch — registry returned 404 on blob mount. Suspect partial upload + cache stamp mismatch.
ci-bot: pipeline 4242: integration-tests (staging) failed — test_user_session_timeout x1 flake (timeout 30s) then artifact fetch error from registry (5xx) — overall pipeline marked failed.
maya: We had a deploybot change yesterday that switched to a different upload strategy to reduce multipart retries. Maybe TTL/manifest sync still racy with remote cache.
ash: @ryan can you try re-running the artifact upload step (build 4211) or re-promote with --reupload? If it's a transient registry 5xx it might pass.
ryan: Tried re-run promote -> fails at blob mount with same digest mismatch. The registry returns "blob not found" when deploy-bot does the mount, but the object exists when I query direct via s3 path. Looks like index/manifest propagation delay between registry and CDN.
olivia: We can't unblock the customer-facing rollout until promote succeeds. Options: 1) hold and retry after cache reindex (unknown ETA), 2) pin release to previous stable image (2026.03.12-rc.4), 3) manually reupload artifact under new tag/digest and promote a new tag. Thoughts?
maya: If we pin to previous image, we should create a short rollback PR to revert the change in release notes and record a follow-up ticket to reattempt. Pinning is low-risk and gets the rollout unblocked quickly.
ash: Agreed. Also recommend we add a safety in deploy-bot to detect manifest propagation by checking registry HEAD on blobs before allowing promote.
ryan: I'll open a quick revert PR and trigger promote for 2026.03.12-rc.4. Also filing INFRA-2897 to track deploy-bot manifest-check improvement.
ci-bot: deploy-bot: promotion request for web-service:2026.03.12-rc.4 queued by ryan. Pipeline 4243 started.
olivia: Thanks. Can someone also purge remote cache/stamp for registry path for the failed artifact so future reuploads don't hit stale index? Maybe that will unblock reupload attempts later.
ryan: Infra team — can you run cache purge on registry prefix /artifacts/web-service/2026.03.20-rc.1? Tagging @ash.
ash: Starting purge now, will report when done. I'll also add a short note in the release channel and mark the original candidate as "blocked - artifact index".
ash: Purge done, propagation requested to CDN. ETA ~4-6 mins.
ci-bot: pipeline 4243: staging integration tests passed. Promote completed for web-service:2026.03.12-rc.4 :shipit:
olivia: Rollout unblocked, moving to canary window. Creating follow-up ticket to reattempt 2026.03.20-rc.1 after manifest-check feature and registry stability. Ticket: REL-4021.
ryan: Will re-run build/reupload once REL-4021 is in progress. Noting we should also increase flaky test timeout for test_user_session_timeout and add better assert logs.
maya: Thanks team. Postmortem to include timeline, root cause (manifest/registry propagation + deploy-bot promote logic), mitigation (pin/rollback + cache purge), and follow-ups (deploy-bot head checks, registry observability). :memo:
